name: label
purpose: Form-field label that pairs descriptive text with an optional required indicator and an optional hint. Renders a native `<label>` element so consumers can associate it with any input via the standard `for` attribute. Use it above (or beside) any input control in the `inputs` category to communicate the field name and whether it must be filled. The required indicator is rendered inline as `* (Required)` — the `*` in the primary orange followed by the parenthesized word "(Required)" in muted text — replacing the older `Tag` badge for a lighter typographic signal. Setting `hint` appends a `Hint` glyph after the text, so a field name and its one-sentence explanation stay one component instead of a hand-built row.
useWhen: Naming a bare input when you compose a field layout yourself.
Marking a field as required with the inline `* (Required)` indicator.
Attaching a one-sentence explanation to a field name with `hint`.
avoidWhen: A standard text, password, select, or textarea field → use `field`, whose `Field.Label` targets the control and shows the Required marker for you.
Guidance, error, or required messages under the input → use `helper-text`.
An info glyph with no field name next to it → use `hint`.
related: helper-text` — the line under the input; pairs with the label above it.
hint` — the glyph the `hint` prop renders; use it alone when there is no label.
field` — composes label, any control, and description/error with the wiring done.
bestPractices: Always set `for` to the input's id (`inputId` on the bare inputs) so clicking the label focuses the control.
required` is visual only; also set `required` on the input so it carries `aria-required`.
Keep `hint` to one short sentence; it is revealed in a tooltip on hover or focus.
Pass the text through `label` or the default slot, not both; the slot wins.

props.name: label
props.doc: Fallback text when the default slot is empty.

props.name: required
props.doc: Appends an inline required indicator (`* (Required)`) next to the label text. The `*` uses `var(--primary)`; "(Required)" inherits `var(--text-muted)`.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Short explanation appended as a `Hint` glyph that reveals it on hover or focus. Empty renders no glyph.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Label text; falls back to `label` prop when empty.

examples.name: Required
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Label from '@aziontech/webkit/label'
</script>

<template>
  <Label
    label="Label"
    required
  />
</template>

examples.name: Hinted
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Label from '@aziontech/webkit/label'
</script>

<template>
  <Label
    label="Sensitive"
    hint="Values are encrypted at rest and never displayed again after saving."
  />
</template>
